text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Everything that happens from now on is real. That's why I have to make sure to witness it with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'll create striking memories for myself—for everyone! And I'll make each and every moment shine brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion doesn't finish her sentence, but it's enough. I understand exactly what she's feeling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day it was decided she would run in the Twinkle Series, Fine Motion's eyes sparkled brightly, and her excitement for the future swelled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she heads towards her glorious finale, she looks more beautiful than I can ever remember seeing her.
choice_data_list: Go out there and have fun!
Go out there and have fun!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy! I'm so thrilled to race alongside you again!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I've been doing a lot of thinking. About how we might not be able to run together in the future.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I was thinking it would be so sad… but then I realized I was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I said you were like the main character of a story. And all stories definitely come to an end. However, there can always be a brand new chapter.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Please allow my name to be among those in the finale of your first chapter!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Aha, what a cool way to put it. You're so delightful, Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll allow me to etch my name into your heart as well…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: As the victor of this race.
